full_judgment: 30. India, of course, is one of the biggest working democracies in the world having a Constitution of its own which remained in force without any interruption for all these years. A decision of the Madras High Court in the case of Madathil Ahmed Haji Vs. Muthana Kunshiram Kurup and another reported in AIR 1954 (Madras) 360, would be relevant. In that case the Madras Village Panchayat Act, 1950 and the Rules made there under namely, Rule 9 prescribing open ballot in case of class II Panchayats was alleged to militate against Article 14 of the Constitution of India. In that case the question of classification being discriminatory and open ballot being unconstitutional was canvassed.
